episodes.title: One
episodes.summary: Sidelined by PTSD, Special Forces veteran John Creasy gets a second chance when an old friend hires him to investigate a terrorist plot in Brazil.

episodes.title: Two
episodes.summary: As they face relentless attacks from all sides, Creasy tries to help Poe reclaim her memories — and discovers no one can really be trusted.

episodes.title: Three
episodes.summary: Creasy leverages Tiago to gain access to Osmar's hideout. Poe befriends a sensitive teen enlisted to protect her from the dangers of the favela.

episodes.title: Four
episodes.summary: The favela goes on high alert when enemies arrive with an agenda. Creasy races against time to extract information in a high-stakes hostage situation.

episodes.title: Five
episodes.summary: With a new adversary on his trail, Creasy hatches a plan to get Poe and the others out of the country. Vico offers Livro a chance at a fresh start.

episodes.title: Six
episodes.summary: Creasy stages a daring prison heist to secure an important target. Melo takes the wheel for a dangerous rescue mission.

episodes.title: Seven
episodes.summary: Cornered and exposed, Creasy sets a trap to lure his enemies into the flames — even if it means he burns alongside them.
